projects.caseStudy: PINTER is the internal AI agent orchestration platform developed for Pupuk Indonesia Holding Company. Enterprise automation requires connecting diverse data systems while enabling non-technical operators to design, inspect, and safely deploy intelligent agent workflows. To solve this, PINTER was engineered around a visual agent builder built with React Flow (@xyflow/react), TanStack Router, and Google Agent Development Kit (ADK). The platform provides 4 native orchestration patterns: single LLM agents, sequential pipelines, parallel fan-outs, and iterative loop agents. Execution steps including internal reasoning, tool calls, tool responses, and agent handoffs are streamed in real-time to the user via Server-Sent Events (SSE) and rendered inside an inline trace viewer. To optimize operational cost and execution speed across multi-agent pipelines, a virtual model layer was introduced. In addition to sequential fallback combos and round-robin load distribution, the platform incorporates a TypeSafe Jev (System One) smart routing engine. TypeSafe Jev evaluates chat query intent against user-defined criteria in ~150ms, producing calibrated confidence scores and probability distributions. If the classification confidence surpasses a defined threshold (default 0.65), the request is automatically routed to a specialized domain model; otherwise, it falls back to a general-purpose model. The system also integrates Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and enterprise SSO (IDENTIK) with AES-256 encrypted credential storage, providing an auditable platform for enterprise-grade autonomous workflows.
details: Architected the migration of a rigid, CLI-based agent prototype into a production-ready enterprise platform using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and custom FastAPI routes.
Designed and implemented the interactive Visual Canvas using React Flow (@xyflow/react) and TanStack Router, representing complex multi-agent topologies and connection graphs.
Engineered multi-agent orchestration supporting 4 native graph patterns: LlmAgent, SequentialAgent, ParallelAgent, and LoopAgent.

Architected TypeSafe Jev (System One) smart routing engine evaluating query intent in ~150ms to dispatch requests to specialized model tiers with calibrated confidence scoring and fallback safety nets.
Built virtual model abstraction layer supporting sequential fallback chains (combos), round-robin load distribution pools, and intent-driven smart routers.

Implemented real-time execution event tracing (tool_call, tool_response, agent_transfer, thinking, smart_routing) streamed to clients via Server-Sent Events (SSE) with interactive inline probability bars.
Built hybrid RAG pipeline connecting Qdrant vector database with semantic chunking and enterprise document ingestion.
Integrated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support (stdio and SSE transports) dynamically loaded from PostgreSQL configurations.
Implemented enterprise identity federation (IDENTIK SSO) with encrypted assertions, RBAC permissions, and AES-256 encrypted credential vaults.
Structured domain-partitioned architecture across 8 core domains (identity, agents, conversations, knowledge, integrations, evaluations, governance, content) with 142 automated backend test suites.
Built user token quota management with budget caps, daily/monthly request limits, and automated cost calculation across LLM providers via LiteLLM.
Integrated interactive data visualization blocks in chat including ECharts, Flint Chart, Mermaid diagrams, and KaTeX math formulas.
projects.rationale: Internal enterprise tool for Pupuk Indonesia Holding Company that democratizes AI agent creation for non-technical teams while optimizing token costs and latency via intelligent routing.
technicalChallenges: Executed a 3-phase framework migration from CrewAI to Google ADK without production downtime, using tool wrapping adapters in Phase 2 before full native rewrite in Phase 3.
Implemented async ORM rewrite with buffered execution tracing that flushes events in batches to avoid per-event DB writes that would kill streaming performance.
Designed a custom instruction merging strategy from CrewAI's 3-field (role/goal/backstory) model to ADK's 5-pattern instruction model (identity/mission/methodology/boundaries/examples).
Integrated TypeSafe Jev System One routing engine with calibrated confidence thresholds (0.65 default), handling route encryption protection and probability distribution parsing.

projects.caseStudy: AeGIS Atlas is the fertilizer demand planning command center for Pupuk Indonesia Holding Company. Agricultural planning across 34 Indonesian provinces requires coordinating soil nutrient data, crop planting timelines, and historical distributor sales. Previous workflows relied on disparate static spreadsheets, preventing rapid audits of safety stock versus actual inventory. Atlas addresses this by combining spatial boundary layers with an interactive calculation engine. Built with React 19, OpenLayers, MapLibre GL, and Deck.gl, the frontend provides immediate visual feedback as planners modify commodity timelines and dosage parameters. To avoid server latency during exploratory planning sessions, the Fertilizer Demand Model (FDM) calculation logic was implemented entirely on the client, backed by 52 automated unit tests verifying stage distribution, land overrides, and regional aggregation. On the backend, a Go Fiber v3 service handles domain data, reference metrics, and vector tile proxying with dual HTTP Basic/HMAC token support, internal token caching, and a 1MB payload response limit. The integrated GeoMind AI workspace provides natural-language insights over regional demand data with streaming SSE responses.

Rebranded AI assistant module to 'GEO Mind' and migrated overview query hooks to dedicated FDM service contract for dynamic stock audits and market penetration logic.
Eliminated national planning blindspots, empowering executives and domain experts to execute live 'Safety Stock vs. Actual Stock' audits across 34 Indonesian provinces.

projects.summary: Enterprise logistics orchestration and automated pathfinding platform built for Pupuk Indonesia Holding Company to manage national bulk fertilizer distribution across maritime shipping lanes and overland transport corridors. Coordinates warehouse inventory balance across 122 facilities (Arca), carrier agreements and tariff audits (Delta), and Neo4j graph-based route simulations (Vista).

projects.caseStudy: NEXUS is the enterprise logistics orchestration platform developed for Pupuk Indonesia Holding Company to oversee national bulk fertilizer distribution across the Indonesian archipelago. Coordinating heavy maritime and overland logistics involves reconciling thousands of carrier contracts, tracking inventory across regional hubs, and determining optimal transit corridors. NEXUS integrates these functions across three complementary modules: Arca, Delta, and Vista. Arca tracks physical stock balances across 122 strategic warehouses down to district kiosks, providing visibility into supply surpluses and local shortages. Delta functions as the contractual and financial governance foundation, managing carrier rate tiers, vessel fleet registries, and shipping agreements. To audit high-density tariff data without UI degradation, Delta utilizes @glideapps/glide-data-grid with server-side validation against active contracts. Vista provides the geospatial pathfinding layer, querying Delta's verified tariffs to simulate multi-hop maritime and land shipping corridors through Neo4j graph traversals and Cypher queries.
details: Architected Single-Repo Multi-Entry frontend using Rsbuild and Bun, supporting compile-time profile switches (APP_MODULE=delta) between standalone Delta (port 3001), Arca, and unified shell (port 3000).
Engineered Arca warehouse hub tracking physical stock balances and flow across 122 strategic warehouses down to district kiosks with surplus/deficit alerts.
Engineered modular database architecture with delta_* table prefixes and strict write-isolation boundaries preventing cross-module corruption.
Developed mathematical pathfinding engine using Neo4j and Cypher queries to simulate optimal multi-hop maritime and land shipping corridors.
Built high-performance financial audit tables using @glideapps/glide-data-grid and monospace typography for contract tariffs and vessel fleet capacities.
Implemented immutable shipping tariff audit logs and anomaly alerts for bulk fertilizer logistics across Indonesian distribution hubs.
Designed custom Excel ingestion pipelines (openpyxl / exceljs) syncing historical transport contracts, rate tiers, and fleet capacities into PostgreSQL.
Engineered full-screen geospatial map simulation in Vista module with OpenLayers, calculating contract-aware shipping costs in real-time.
Enforced WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards with oklch-based color palette ('The Cartographic Monolith') across high-density logistics dashboards.
projects.rationale: Internal enterprise logistics coordination and automated route pathfinding platform built for Pupuk Indonesia Holding Company to manage and optimize heavy bulk fertilizer distribution across the Indonesian archipelago.
technicalChallenges: Developed a highly performant mathematical route pathfinding engine to solve complex multi-stop marine logistics and cost-minimization problems.
Designed a comprehensive database schema (using route segments, rate tiers, and contracts) capable of performing water-tight, contract-aware shipping tariff audits.
Adhered to strict 'The Cartographic Monolith' design system using oklch colors with extreme selectively-contrasting highlights and zero drop-shadow elevations.
Optimized high-density data tables containing thousands of tariff records with server-side validation against active carrier contracts.

projects.title: Land Delineation Training
projects.description: Deep learning model training pipeline for delineating land from satellite imagery. Features preprocessing, BsiNet model implementation, and custom loss functions.
details: Developed a deep learning pipeline for land delineation using BsiNet architecture.
Implemented preprocessing modules using GDAL for satellite imagery (GeoTIFF) handling, including normalization, mask binarization, and resampling.

Set up a training loop with TensorBoard logging for monitoring model performance.
Built a testing script to generate binary masks from model predictions and save them as GeoTIFFs.
